Keep the white/gray triangle and neutral shadow unchanged. No redesign, no extra elements, no text, no outline, no border, no badge, no 3D, no background rectangle. Return a clean square transparent PNG suitable for a multi-size Windows ICO; maintain the original icon's proportions and alignment.

Use case: precise-object-edit, transparent Windows application icon cleanup. Image 1 is the BLUE edit target. Image 2 is the original LLPlayer geometry reference only. Keep Image 1's blue speech bubble, white play triangle, shadow, exact relative shape, size and alignment unchanged. Make one narrowly targeted correction: eliminate every isolated blue fleck, speck, blob, halo or disconnected fragment outside the bubble. The complete exterior around the bubble must be clean fully transparent alpha, with only a smooth antialiased boundary. Preserve the lower-left speech tail and the original silhouette of Image 2. Keep the blue gradient, white triangle and neutral triangle drop shadow; do not add texture or change design, zoom, proportions, canvas framing or colors. conversion: Pillow 12.3.0: original selected generated RGBA PNG downsampled to 256x256 with LANCZOS. Existing unchanged 256x256 PNG encoded as 32-bit DIB/BMP ICO frames using bitmap_format=bmp. No manual recolor, alpha masking, cropping or redraw.

ico.and_mask: No 1-bpp AND mask follows any frame: bytesInRes is 40+4*w*h and biHeight is twice the frame height, so Windows must rely on the 32-bpp alpha channel. Windows 10/11 renders these frames correctly (verified by CreateIconFromResourceEx loading all seven and by the user-confirmed blue Desktop icon). This is a container-format deviation, not an established cause of the earlier white icon.

verification.qualitative: Speech bubble, tail, centered white play triangle, neutral triangle shadow and blue gradient visually inspected at desktop-icon size. Generative edit is not claimed pixel-identical to original.
